readings: For each corpeventprx value in sentimentandfundamentals, with rows whose corpeventprx is NULL forming their own group, return the average anlycount and the average signed gap inholdpct minus instownpct. Rows where either ownership value is missing are left out of the gap average. Also return each group's average gap minus the unweighted mean of all groups' average gaps, with the NULL group counted as one group. That difference can be negative. Return no rows if the overall mean is NULL. Do not round anything.

For each corpeventprx value in sentimentandfundamentals, with rows whose corpeventprx is NULL forming their own group, return the average anlycount and the average absolute gap ABS(inholdpct - instownpct). Rows where either ownership value is missing are left out of the gap average. Also return each group's average absolute gap minus the unweighted mean of all groups' average absolute gaps, with the NULL group counted as one group. That difference can be negative. Return no rows if the overall mean is NULL. Do not round anything.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT corpeventprx,
         AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
         AVG(CASE WHEN inholdpct IS NOT NULL AND instownpct IS NOT NULL THEN inholdpct - instownpct END) AS avg_gap
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gap) AS overall_mean FROM g
)
SELECT g.corpeventprx,
       g.avg_anlycount,
       g.avg_gap,
       g.avg_gap - m.overall_mean AS gap_diff
FROM g, m
WHERE m.overall_mean IS NOT NULL;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT corpeventprx,
         AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anly,
         AVG(CASE WHEN inholdpct IS NOT NULL AND instownpct IS NOT NULL THEN ABS(inholdpct - instownpct) END) AS avg_gap
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
)
SELECT corpeventprx,
       avg_anly,
       avg_gap,
       avg_gap - (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) FROM g) AS gap_diff
FROM g
WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) FROM g) IS NOT NULL;
